tokens.name: creamsicle
tokens.usage: Lungfish Creamsicle, the primary brand color. Logo, the accent bar under headings, links, active markers, CTAs and the first data series. Never body text: 2.3:1 on `cream`, so pair it with an ink label or keep it to marks 24px and up.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Secondary warm tint. Callout washes, chart secondaries, the icon wells behind app glyphs. Never put `creamsicle` on Peach (muddy).

tokens.name: deep-ink
tokens.usage: Warm near-black. Primary text on `cream`, dark backgrounds, table headers. Never use pure black.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page and canvas background, card surfaces in print. Never pure white. Text on Deep Ink is Cream, never white.

tokens.name: warm-grey
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, the TOC idle state. 3.4:1 on `cream`, so keep it to captions and labels 14px semibold and up, never paragraphs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text in UI. `deep-ink` on light grounds, `cream` on dark grounds. 15.8:1 on `canvas` light, 14.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App window and page background (LungfishCanvasBackground). Light is Cream, dark is Deep Ink lifted 4% toward white.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and tile fill on `canvas` (LungfishCardBackground). Light is white inside the app, dark is Deep Ink lifted 12%.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Welcome sidebar and source-list fill (LungfishSidebarBackground). Cream blended 42% with Peach in light, Deep Ink blended 16% with Peach in dark.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around cards, tiles and dividers (LungfishStroke). Decorative only, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, paths, dates (LungfishSecondaryText). Light is Warm Grey (3.7:1 on `card`, 3.4:1 on `canvas`, a source pair below 4.5:1 kept as is). Dark is 9:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline section divider on `cream` in the docs site (h2 top border, title-block bottom border).

tokens.name: code-fill
tokens.usage: Inline and block code background in the docs site and user manual.

tokens.name: lungfish-orange
tokens.usage: App accent color (AccentColor and LungfishOrange asset). Tool icons and branded UI in the macOS app. 3.1:1 on white, for icons and marks, not text. The brand manual's canonical accent is `creamsicle`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Lungfish Teal, secondary app color. FASTQ read bodies and sparkline fills.

tokens.name: teal-dark
tokens.usage: Darker Teal step (LungfishTealDark asset). Outlines and emphasis on Teal fills.

tokens.name: teal-light
tokens.usage: Lighter Teal step (LungfishTealLight asset). Highlights on Teal fills.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Lungfish Sage. Ready and success state dots, the `success-fill` source.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Muted clay for destructive actions and error states (LungfishDanger), used instead of system red. 4.9:1 on `card` light.

tokens.name: selection-fill
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row fill (LungfishWelcomeSelectionFill). The row's label and glyph turn `creamsicle`.

tokens.name: attention-fill
tokens.usage: Needs-attention backgrounds (LungfishAttentionFill).

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Ready and success backgrounds (LungfishSuccessFill).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button bezel and error backgrounds (LungfishDangerFill).

tokens.name: muted-fill
tokens.usage: Quiet Peach wash for inactive panels (LungfishMutedFill).

tokens.name: icon-well
tokens.usage: Rounded square behind a `creamsicle` glyph on tiles and project rows (LungfishWelcomeIconBackground).

tokens.name: base-a
tokens.usage: Nucleotide A in sequence and read views (default, user-adjustable in Settings > Appearance).

tokens.name: base-t
tokens.usage: Nucleotide T (and U) in sequence and read views.

tokens.name: base-g
tokens.usage: Nucleotide G in sequence and read views. Gold, so letters on it use `deep-ink`.

tokens.name: base-c
tokens.usage: Nucleotide C in sequence and read views.

tokens.name: base-n
tokens.usage: Ambiguous base N in sequence views.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page and cover titles, with the Creamsicle bar beneath. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings, sentence case, a `rule` hairline above. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Subsections and card titles. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Air sampling is a leading indicator of emerging threats.
styles.usage: All long-form text, max 68ch per line. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: How to read a pileup and judge a variant
styles.usage: One sentence-case line under a page title, in `deep-ink`. Replaces eyebrows, which the system does not use. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, CLI, data tables, sequencing output, on `code-fill`. Docs and site only, never in the app.

styles.name: app-sidebar-title
styles.usage: Sidebar heading and large empty-state glyphs.

styles.name: app-nav
styles.usage: Sidebar navigation rows. Tile descriptions use the same size at 400.

styles.name: app-label
styles.usage: Default control and table text across viewports (the most used size).

styles.name: app-mono
styles.usage: Sequence letters and numeric columns in the app. SF Mono through the monospaced system font, never IBM Plex Mono.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges inside dense table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its secondary line. The most used padding in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Brand base grid unit. Gap between stacked project rows and inside pills.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap in rows and pills.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default panel padding in viewports and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gutter between Welcome tiles and around the window content. Horizontal padding of project rows.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Launch tile padding and the gap between its icon well and title.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Welcome content padding and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Minimum screen margin for brand pages (print minimum is 25mm).

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Small badges and inline chips in viewports.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: The most common app radius: table chips, screenshot frames, small panels.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Docs callouts and images.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Sidebar row highlight and the 40px project icon well.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: The 72px app icon on the download card.

tokens.name: radius-18
tokens.usage: The 54px icon well on launch tiles.

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: Recent project rows and empty-state panels.

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: Launch tiles.

tokens.name: radius-30
tokens.usage: The Welcome window's content panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills (continuous capsule).

tokens.name: accent-bar-height
tokens.usage: Creamsicle bar under every H1 (5px on the site, 4px in the manual; brand range 4 to 6px).

tokens.name: accent-bar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the Creamsicle bar.

tokens.name: callout-edge
tokens.usage: Left Creamsicle edge on docs callouts and the active TOC marker (2px).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled tiles and rows in the app.

tokens.name: opacity-hover-stroke
tokens.usage: `creamsicle` stroke strength on a hovered launch tile (0.28 on project rows).
